text:
matt: Heads up — a customer hit a nasty failure mode: large embeddings batch with mixed dims and >10MB payload. Which slicing policy should win: byte-slicing vs dim-preserving? Logs just show 413s and it's hard to tell.
sophie: We currently prefer dim-preserving splits so we don't corrupt embeddings. But that can create lots of tiny requests and blow quotas. Proposal: if mixed dims, try dim-preserving first; if the resulting plan would exceed MAX_BATCH_TOKENS or MAX_BYTES, fallback to byte-slice and annotate responses with `X-Embed-Split: byte`. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
raj: +1 to the fallback, but we need clear telemetry. Tag events with `split.kind` and `split.reason`. Also add an opt-in preflight that returns a `split_plan` so SDKs/console can show estimated cost and route candidates.
ben: We must be careful about attribution. When fallback happens, quota/usage should be attributed to the original request route so customers don't see mysterious double-charges. Also want a standard hint on 413: `X-Embed-Suggest-Split: dim|byte` so clients know next step. :thumbsup:
ana: Rollout note — default behavior should not change for Dedicated/reserved customers unless they explicitly opt in. For hosted accounts, feature-flag the new precedence and collect telemetry for 2 weeks before flipping. Support docs need a short how-to.
matt: Can we add a non-breaking preflight endpoint? `/v1/embeddings:preflight` that returns a `split_plan` + `est_cost_units`. Console can call it and show "expected cost" and a preview of split. Example response:

```json
{"split_plan": [{"kind": "dim-preserve", "chunks": 3}, {"kind": "byte-slice", "chunks": 2}], "est_cost_units": 42}
```
sophie: SDK change is tiny. Also add header negotiation: `X-Embed-Allow-ByteSplit: true|false`. If unset, server uses precedence policy. For rollout we'll default to unset and opt-in clients can set headers.
ben: Edge-case: compressed payloads. We must compute bytes-on-wire (gzip) when deciding to slice. Logging should capture `payload_compressed_bytes` and `split_bytes_after_compression`.
raj: I'll add telemetry events: `embed_split_planned`, `embed_split_executed`, `embed_preflight_called`. Include fields: `original_count`, `dims_set`, `split_kind`, `bytes_before`, `bytes_after`, `route_candidate`. Dashboard: split rate, 413 rate, avg extra units from fallback.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: eng-platform/split-policy v2 -> canary @ 2026-04-12T01:00Z
ana: Support runbook snippet: "When a customer sees 413, check `split.kind` in logs, advise client to call `/v1/embeddings:preflight` and/or set `X-Embed-Allow-ByteSplit` based on tolerance." I'll draft a KB.
matt: Action items: sophie implement header + preflight API; raj add telemetry events & Grafana panels; ben handle quota attribution change and 413 hint header; ana own rollout + support doc. I'll open PRs and link them here. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
